verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the UCP protocol specification and its reference implementations are public on GitHub, but that covers an industry-governed protocol, not Shopify's own product. Nothing in the pack shows Shopify's MCP servers, the @shopify/ucp-cli, or the AI Toolkit source being readable under an open license. An open protocol spec is an adjacent artifact, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
